text: Volkswagen AG indirectly holds 75.4% of the share capital of Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG, via Porsche Holding Stuttgart GmbH. Porsche AG states that its ordinary shares are held indirectly by Volkswagen AG and Porsche SE, and the majority of its preferred shares indirectly by Volkswagen AG. The Volkswagen Group lists Porsche AG among the companies in which Volkswagen AG holds direct or indirect interests.
short: Volkswagen AG indirectly holds 75.4% of Porsche AG’s share capital.
